$comment: The cross-stack-determinism capability's deviation register (openspec: cross-stack-determinism,
requirement 'The Capability's Deviation Register Bridges Known Violations Across Its Checks').
ONE register for the whole capability — no check maintains its own. Each entry admits a KNOWN,
FILED, not-yet-fixed violation past exactly the check(s) and site(s) it names, and nothing else.
An entry is valid only while its referenced defect doc under docs/defects/ carries a
'**Status:** open' line. The change that fixes a defect flips that line to
'**Status:** fixed (<change-id>)' and REMOVES the entry here in the same commit — a stale entry
fails every check that consults it. Checks print this register's contents on every run.
Entry shape: 'file' is repo-relative; 'checks' maps a check slug (see 'checks' legend) to the
line numbers it suppresses in that file ([] = suppression keyed on the named family/function,
not lines). 'magnitude' is 'unmeasured' or 'measured (<basis>)' — never a bare 'measured'.
Line numbers are load-bearing: if a site drifts, the consulting check fails until the entry is
updated, which keeps every suppression a reviewable diff.

checks.cross-target: Rule-Bearing Values Are Reproducible Across Build Targets of the Same Language — enforced by .claude/scripts/check-fma-contraction.sh (compiled-output FMADDD/FMSUBD inspection, arm64 vs amd64/GOAMD64=v1) and the amd64 differential board-test leg in /check
checks.golden-fixture-sweep: Shared Board Math Is Pinned By a Cross-Language Golden Fixture — the exhaustive-sweep clause; a listed family's sweep case is BLOCKED until its defect is fixed (recording it now would freeze one architecture's answers)
checks.transcendental-drift: Rule-Bearing Values Cross the Seam By Exact Arithmetic or By Discretization — enforced by .claude/scripts/check-transcendental.sh (textual lint: transcendentals, sqrt, bare Round)
checks.sqrt-pinning: Square Roots In Rules Are Pinned, Not Assumed — a runtime sqrt reaching a rule-bearing value with no fixture family pinning it
checks.discretized-choice: Inexact Arithmetic Is Rule-Bearing Only Through a Discretized, Tie-Broken Choice

entries.note: One site, three checks bridged (defect doc §1–3): FMA contraction in laneLength; runtime math.Sqrt with no fixture family (Go-only mirror — Go-side fixture obligation per design.md); bare math.Round into the persisted ETA.
